theorem ReviewI.Integration.both_tests_full_source_shells.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] [inst_2 : MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  [inst_4 : mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [inst_5 : SFinite mu] [inst_6 : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  [inst_7 : MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) (a l r s : ℝ)
  (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi),
  (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0) →
    ∀ (v : ℕ → NumberField.FinitePlace K) (indent : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K → ℝ),
      Continuous indent →
        (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), 0 ≤ indent x) →
          (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), HasSum (fun t => indent ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) t * x)) 1) →
            ∀ (q : Fin 2) (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
              let h := LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q;
              have ht := ⋯;
              have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs h ⋯ ⋯;
              let V := JThetaAttachment.fullSourceSpan K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
              have Theta := OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
              let E := DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0 Theta;
              have S :=
                (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s).starProjection;
              have b := fun x =>
                PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
              have p := NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent;
              have d := fun T x => DSourceKernel.residualKernel mu b (E T) A (fun x y => h (x * y⁻¹)) x x;
              (∀ (chi : MasulloGRH.UnitaryHeckeCharacter K),
                  JThetaAttachment.thetaClosure K addHaar mu chi (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s ≤
                    JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s) ∧
                (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
                    (fun x => ↑↑((E T).starProjection (A F)) x) =ᶠ[ae mu] fun x =>
                      ↑(b x) *
                        ∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                          DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y)) ∂mu) ∧
                  (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
                      Integrable (fun x => DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x) mu ∧
                        ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x ∂mu =
                            Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A) ∧
                          HasSum
                              (fun e =>
                                ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                                  ↑(p e x) * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x ∂mu)
                              (Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A)) ∧
                            HasSum (fun e => ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ↑(p e x) * d T x ∂mu)
                                (-Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A)) ∧
                              (Summable fun e => ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ↑(p e x) * d T x ∂mu‖) ∧
                                ∑' (e : Option ℕ), ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ↑(p e x) * d T x ∂mu‖ ≤
                                    ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖d T x‖ ∂mu ∧
                                  Tendsto
                                    (fun n =>
                                      ∑' (e : Option ℕ),
                                        ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                                              ↑(p e x) * (DReview.physicalBand K n).indicator (d T) x ∂mu -
                                            ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ↑(p e x) * d T x ∂mu‖)
                                    atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧
                    Tendsto (fun T => A F - (E T).starProjection (A F)) atTop (𝓝 (A F - S (A F))) :=

    [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] mu [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
    [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] addHaar a l r s hlr hs phi hh hc hphi v indent hindcont hind hmass q
    F =>
  id
    (let h := LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q;
    let A :=
      PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs h
        (LIntegrated.requiredTest_compact K phi hh hc q).left (LIntegrated.requiredTest_compact K phi hh hc q).right;
    let V := JThetaAttachment.fullSourceSpan K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
    let Theta := OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
    ⟨fun chi => JThetaAttachment.thetaClosure_le_fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu chi (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s,
      ⟨fun T =>
        DSourceKernel.finiteKernel_action mu
          (fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x))
          (fun x =>
            id
              (id
                (mul_pos
                  (Real.exp_pos
                    (max (l * Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) (r * Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x)))
                  (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos
                    (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
                      (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one)
                        (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 1)))
                      (Even.pow_nonneg (even_two_mul 1) (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x)))
                    (s / 4)))))
          (DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0
            (OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s) T)
          A F,
        ⟨fun T =>
          And.casesOn
            (ReviewI.Integration.finite_interval_source_shells K mu l r s hlr hs
              (DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0 Theta T) phi hh hc hphi v indent hindcont hind hmass q)
            fun hki right =>
            And.casesOn right fun hktrace right =>
              And.casesOn right fun hsource right =>
                And.casesOn right fun left right =>
                  And.casesOn right fun left right =>
                    And.casesOn right fun hresidual right =>
                      And.casesOn right fun hsum right =>
                        And.casesOn right fun hbound hlim =>
                          ⟨hki, ⟨hktrace, ⟨hsource, ⟨hresidual, ⟨hsum, ⟨hbound, hlim⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩,
          have hlim :=
            (DSourceKernel.source_kernel_global_connection mu
                (fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x))
                (fun x =>
                  id
                    (id
                      (mul_pos
                        (Real.exp_pos
                          (max (l * Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x)
                            (r * Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x)))
                        (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos
                          (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
                            (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one)
                              (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 1)))
                            (Even.pow_nonneg (even_two_mul 1) (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x)))
                          (s / 4)))))
                0 0 Theta A F).right;
          have hp := OAllCharacterClosure.full_sourceProjection_eq K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
          Eq.mp
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                Tendsto (fun T => A F - (DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0 Theta T).starProjection (A F)) atTop
                  (𝓝 (A F - _a (A F))))
              hp)
            hlim⟩⟩⟩)
